integrity: The point counts were recomputed by exhaustive weighted-projective enumeration and checked at F4 with a separate multiplication-table implementation. The zeta factors are derived from the recovered Frobenius characteristic polynomials and the cited zeta-function formula. No independent external audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the three named degree-two singular del Pezzo surfaces are treated. The all-extension formulas use the cited Frobenius trace theorem plus exact trace reconstruction; finite point counts alone do not prove the infinite family. Global priority is not certified by search.
title: Extension-field zeta profiles of three degree-two singular del Pezzo surfaces
